title.en: Saul, the first king of Israel

en: Saul son of Kish, a Benjaminite, is handsome and a head taller than anyone.
Looking for his father's lost donkeys, Saul comes to the seer, Samuel.
The day before, the LORD told Samuel to anoint a man from Benjamin as ruler.
Samuel pours oil on Saul's head and tells him of signs to come.
God changes Saul's heart; the Spirit of God rushes on him, and he prophesies.
At Mizpah Saul is chosen by lot and found hiding among the baggage.
The people shout, "Long live the king!" but some worthless men despise him.
zh: 便雅憫人基士的兒子掃羅相貌俊美，比所有的人都高出一個頭。
掃羅尋找他父親走失的驢，來到先見撒母耳那裏。
前一天，耶和華吩咐撒母耳膏一個便雅憫人作領袖。
撒母耳把油倒在掃羅頭上，告訴他將要應驗的兆頭。
神給掃羅另一顆心；神的靈猛然臨到他，他就說預言。
在米斯巴，掃羅抽籤被選出，人們發現他躲在行李中間。
百姓歡呼：「願王萬歲！」但有些無賴之徒藐視他。

about.en: Saul rescues Jabesh-gilead, and the kingdom is renewed
about.zh: 掃羅救基列‧雅比，重新立國

about.en: Paul: God gave them Saul for forty years
about.zh: 保羅說神將掃羅賜給他們四十年

about.en: Paul, whose Hebrew name was Saul, also of the tribe of Benjamin
about.zh: 保羅（原名掃羅）也是便雅憫支派的人

en: Saul reigned about 1050–1010 BC. The numbers for his age and years in 1 Samuel 13:1 have been lost from the Hebrew text.
Saul's town, Gibeah, is usually identified with Tell el-Ful, about 5 km north of Jerusalem.
There were no coins yet. A quarter shekel was a small piece of silver weighed out, about 3 grams.
zh: 掃羅作王約在主前1050至1010年。撒母耳記上13章1節記他年歲和在位年數的數字，在希伯來文抄本中已經失傳。
掃羅的家鄉基比亞通常被認為是耶路撒冷以北約5公里的富勒丘。
那時還沒有錢幣。四分之一舍客勒是稱出來的一小塊銀子，約3克。

en: At Gilgal Saul waits seven days for Samuel, and his troops begin to scatter.
Saul offers the burnt offering himself; Samuel arrives just as he finishes.
Samuel: your kingdom will not last; the LORD has sought a man after his own heart.
The LORD sends Saul to devote the Amalekites to destruction.
Saul spares King Agag and the best of the sheep and cattle.
Samuel: "To obey is better than sacrifice." The LORD has rejected Saul as king.
Saul seizes Samuel's robe and it tears: the LORD has torn the kingdom from him.
zh: 掃羅在吉甲等候撒母耳七天，軍兵開始離開他散去。
掃羅自己獻上燔祭；剛獻完，撒母耳就到了。
撒母耳說：你的王國必不長久；耶和華已經尋到一個合他心意的人。
耶和華差遣掃羅去把亞瑪力人完全毀滅。
掃羅卻留下亞甲王和上好的牛羊。
撒母耳說：「聽從勝過獻祭。」耶和華已經厭棄掃羅作王。
掃羅抓住撒母耳的外袍，衣角撕裂了：耶和華已使國從他身上撕裂。

about.en: Amalek attacks Israel in the wilderness
about.zh: 亞瑪力人在曠野攻擊以色列

about.en: Hosea: faithful love, not sacrifice
about.zh: 何西阿：我喜愛慈愛，不喜愛祭祀

about.en: Paul: God found David, a man after his heart
about.zh: 保羅說神尋得大衛，是合他心意的人

en: Michmash, today's Mukhmas, lies about 11 km northeast of Jerusalem, across a steep gorge from Geba.
The Philistines kept control of iron-working (13:19-22). Small stone weights marked pim, about two-thirds of a shekel, have been found.
The Amalekites were nomads of the Negev and Sinai deserts, south of Judah.
zh: 密抹就是今天的穆赫馬斯，在耶路撒冷東北約11公里，與迦巴隔着一道陡峭的峽谷。
非利士人控制了打鐵的技術（13章19至22節）。考古出土過刻有「皮姆」的小石砝碼，約為三分之二舍客勒。
亞瑪力人是遊牧民族，住在猶大以南的南地和西奈曠野。

en: The LORD sends Samuel with a horn of oil to Jesse of Bethlehem.
Samuel sees Eliab and thinks he must be the LORD's anointed.
The LORD: people look at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.
Seven of Jesse's sons pass before Samuel, but the LORD has chosen none of them.
The youngest, David, is brought in from the sheep, and Samuel anoints him.
The Spirit of the LORD rushes on David; the Spirit has left Saul.
David plays the lyre for Saul and becomes his armor-bearer.
zh: 耶和華差遣撒母耳帶着一角油，到伯利恆人耶西那裏去。
撒母耳看見以利押，心想他一定就是耶和華的受膏者。
耶和華說：人是看外表，耶和華卻是看內心。
耶西的七個兒子從撒母耳面前經過，耶和華都沒有揀選。
最小的大衛從羊群那裏被帶來，撒母耳就膏了他。
耶和華的靈猛然臨到大衛；耶和華的靈已經離開了掃羅。
大衛為掃羅彈琴，並作了替他拿兵器的人。

about.en: God chose David from the sheepfolds to shepherd Israel
about.zh: 神從羊圈中揀選大衛牧養以色列

about.en: A shoot from the stump of Jesse
about.zh: 從耶西的樹墩必發出嫩枝

about.en: Joseph goes to Bethlehem, the town of David
about.zh: 約瑟上大衛的城伯利恆去

en: Pouring olive oil on the head set apart kings and priests. "Anointed one" is mashiach in Hebrew, from which comes "Messiah".
The lyre (kinnor) was a small stringed instrument held in the arms; lyres appear in Egyptian and Mesopotamian art.
David's reign is usually dated about 1010–970 BC.
zh: 把橄欖油倒在頭上，表示分別人作王或作祭司。「受膏者」希伯來文是mashiach，「彌賽亞」一詞就由此而來。
琴（kinnor）是抱在臂中彈奏的小型弦樂器，在埃及和美索不達米亞的藝術中都可以看到。
大衛作王的年代通常定在約主前1010至970年。

en: The Philistines and Israel face each other across the Valley of Elah.
Goliath of Gath, six cubits and a span tall, defies Israel morning and evening for forty days.
Jesse sends David with food for his brothers, and David hears the challenge.
David tells Saul the LORD who rescued him from lion and bear will rescue him.
He puts off Saul's armor and takes his staff, five smooth stones and his sling.
David: "I come against you in the name of the LORD of Armies. The battle is the LORD's."
David's stone strikes Goliath's forehead, and Israel pursues the Philistines.
zh: 非利士人和以色列人隔着以拉谷對陣。
迦特人歌利亞身高六肘零一虎口，早晚向以色列挑戰，一連四十天。
耶西派大衛給哥哥們送糧食，大衛聽見了那挑戰。
大衛對掃羅說，救他脫離獅子和熊的耶和華必救他。
他脫下掃羅的盔甲，拿着杖、五塊光滑的石子和機弦。
大衛說：「我來攻擊你，靠的是萬軍之耶和華的名；這場戰爭是屬於耶和華的。」
大衛的石子打中歌利亞的額頭，以色列人就追趕非利士人。

about.en: The women sing of Saul's thousands and David's ten thousands
about.zh: 婦女唱：掃羅殺敵千千，大衛殺敵萬萬

about.en: Goliath's sword kept at Nob
about.zh: 歌利亞的刀存放在挪伯

about.en: David among those who became mighty in war by faith
about.zh: 大衛列在憑信心爭戰得勝的人中

en: The Valley of Elah lies about 25 km southwest of Jerusalem. Khirbet Qeiyafa, a fortress of about 1000 BC, overlooks it.
Six cubits and a span is about 2.9 m. The Septuagint and a Dead Sea Scroll of Samuel read four cubits and a span, about 2 m.
Goliath's coat of armor weighed 5,000 shekels, about 57 kg. Sling stones the size of a tennis ball are found at many ancient battle sites.
zh: 以拉谷在耶路撒冷西南約25公里。約主前1000年的凱亞法要塞就俯瞰這山谷。
六肘零一虎口約2.9米。七十士譯本和一份撒母耳記的死海古卷作「四肘零一虎口」，約2米。
歌利亞的鎧甲重五千舍客勒，約57公斤。許多古代戰場都出土過網球大小的機弦石子。

en: Saul takes three thousand men to hunt David in the wilderness of En-gedi.
Saul goes into a cave where David and his men are sitting in the back.
David secretly cuts off the corner of Saul's robe, then his conscience troubles him.
He will not raise his hand against the LORD's anointed; Saul weeps aloud.
Later David and Abishai find Saul asleep in his camp in the wilderness of Ziph.
David will not let Abishai kill Saul; he takes Saul's spear and water jug.
Saul says, "I have sinned," and blesses David.
zh: 掃羅帶三千人到隱‧基底的曠野搜索大衛。
掃羅進了一個洞，大衛和他的部下正坐在洞的深處。
大衛悄悄割下掃羅外袍的衣襟，事後心中自責。
他不肯伸手害耶和華的受膏者；掃羅放聲大哭。
後來大衛和亞比篩在西弗曠野發現掃羅在營中熟睡。
大衛不准亞比篩殺掃羅，只拿走掃羅的槍和水壺。
掃羅說：「我犯罪了。」又祝福大衛。

about.en: A psalm of David "when he fled from Saul, in the cave"
about.zh: 大衛在洞裏逃避掃羅時的詩

about.en: Paul: do not take revenge; leave it to God
about.zh: 保羅說：不要自己伸冤，讓神處理

about.en: Saul and Jonathan die on Mount Gilboa
about.zh: 掃羅和約拿單死在基利波山

en: En-gedi is an oasis with springs on the western shore of the Dead Sea. Its limestone cliffs are full of caves, and wild ibex still live there.
The Dead Sea lies about 430 m below sea level, the lowest place on land.
Ziph is Tell Zif, about 6 km southeast of Hebron, at the edge of the Judean wilderness.
zh: 隱‧基底是死海西岸有泉水的綠洲，石灰岩懸崖上有許多洞穴，至今仍有野山羊在那裏生活。
死海低於海平面約430米，是陸地上最低的地方。
西弗就是希伯崙東南約6公里的西弗丘，在猶大曠野的邊緣。

en: After Saul's death, David asks the LORD and is sent to Hebron.
The men of Judah anoint David king over the house of Judah.
Abner makes Saul's son Ish-bosheth king over Israel.
David reigns in Hebron over Judah seven years and six months.
All the tribes come to Hebron, and the elders anoint David king over Israel.
David captures the stronghold of Zion from the Jebusites: the City of David.
Hiram king of Tyre sends cedar and craftsmen to build David a house.
zh: 掃羅死後，大衛求問耶和華，耶和華叫他上希伯崙去。
猶大人膏大衛作猶大家的王。
押尼珥立掃羅的兒子伊施波設作以色列的王。
大衛在希伯崙作猶大的王七年零六個月。
以色列各支派都來到希伯崙，長老們膏大衛作以色列的王。
大衛從耶布斯人手中攻取錫安的要塞，就是大衛城。
推羅王希蘭送來香柏木和工匠，為大衛建造宮殿。

about.en: David's lament for Saul and Jonathan
about.zh: 大衛為掃羅和約拿單作的哀歌

about.en: The same events told in Chronicles
about.zh: 歷代志記載的同一件事

about.en: David brings the ark up to the City of David
about.zh: 大衛把約櫃運到大衛城

en: Hebron lies about 30 km south of Jerusalem. The Cave of Machpelah, Abraham's family tomb, is traditionally placed there.
The City of David is a narrow ridge south of today's Temple Mount, above the Gihon spring, Jerusalem's main water source.
Tyre was a Phoenician port on the coast of today's Lebanon. The cedars of Lebanon were prized building timber across the ancient world.
zh: 希伯崙在耶路撒冷以南約30公里。按傳統，亞伯拉罕家族的墓地麥比拉洞就在那裏。
大衛城是今天聖殿山以南的一道狹長山脊，下面就是耶路撒冷的主要水源基訓泉。
推羅是腓尼基的港口，在今黎巴嫩沿海。黎巴嫩的香柏木是古代各地珍貴的建材。

en: David, living in a house of cedar, wants to build a house for the ark of God.
That night the LORD tells Nathan that David is not the one to build him a house.
The LORD took David from the pasture, from following the sheep, to rule Israel.
The LORD will make a house for David: a family line of kings.
David's offspring will build a house for God's name; his throne will stand forever.
"I will be his father, and he will be my son."
David sits before the LORD and prays, "Who am I, Lord GOD?"
zh: 大衛住在香柏木的宮殿裏，想為神的約櫃建造殿宇。
當夜耶和華告訴拿單，建殿的不是大衛。
耶和華把大衛從羊圈、從跟在羊群後面的工作中選召出來，治理以色列。
耶和華要為大衛建立家室，就是世代作王的家族。
大衛的後裔要為神的名建殿；他的國位必堅立，直到永遠。
「我要作他的父親，他要作我的兒子。」
大衛坐在耶和華面前禱告：「主耶和華啊，我是誰？」

about.en: A psalm recalls God's oath to David
about.zh: 詩篇記念神向大衛起的誓

about.en: Gabriel: Jesus will have the throne of his ancestor David
about.zh: 天使說：耶穌要得他祖先大衛的王位

about.en: Paul: from David's descendants God brought Jesus
about.zh: 保羅說：神從大衛的後裔帶來耶穌

about.en: "I will be his father" applied to the Son
about.zh: 「我要作他的父親」用在子身上

en: The Hebrew bayit, "house", can mean a palace, a temple or a family line; the chapter uses all three.
An Aramaic inscription of the 800s BC, found at Tel Dan in 1993, speaks of the "house of David".
David's descendants ruled Judah for about 400 years, until Babylon took Jerusalem in 586 BC.
zh: 希伯來文bayit（「家」或「殿」）可以指宮殿、聖殿或家族；本章三個意思都用到了。
1993年在但丘出土的一塊主前九世紀亞蘭文碑文，提到「大衛家」。
大衛的後裔統治猶大約四百年，直到主前586年巴比倫攻取耶路撒冷。

en: While Israel's army besieges Rabbah, David stays in Jerusalem.
David takes Bathsheba, wife of Uriah the Hittite, and she becomes pregnant.
David has Joab put Uriah where the fighting is fiercest, and Uriah is killed.
Nathan tells of a rich man who took a poor man's only lamb.
David burns with anger at the rich man; Nathan says, "You are the man!"
David says, "I have sinned against the LORD"; the child dies on the seventh day.
In Psalm 51 David asks God to wash him and create a clean heart in him.
zh: 以色列軍隊圍攻拉巴的時候，大衛留在耶路撒冷。
大衛佔有了赫人烏利亞的妻子拔示巴，她就懷了孕。
大衛叫約押派烏利亞到戰鬥最激烈的地方，烏利亞就陣亡了。
拿單講了一個故事：富人奪去了窮人唯一的小羊羔。
大衛向那富人大發怒氣；拿單說：「你就是那人！」
大衛說：「我得罪耶和華了。」那孩子在第七天死了。
在詩篇第51篇，大衛求神洗淨他，為他造一顆清潔的心。

about.en: Happy is the one whose sin is forgiven
about.zh: 得赦免其過的人是有福的

about.en: Paul quotes David on forgiveness
about.zh: 保羅引用大衛論赦罪的話

about.en: David did right, except in the matter of Uriah
about.zh: 大衛行正事，只是在烏利亞的事上例外

about.en: "David fathered Solomon by the wife of Uriah"
about.zh: 「大衛從烏利亞的妻子生所羅門」

en: Rabbah of the Ammonites is Amman, the capital of Jordan; ancient remains stand on its Citadel hill.
The Hittites ruled an empire in Anatolia (Turkey) until about 1180 BC. People called Hittites also lived in Canaan.
In this Bible's numbering, Psalm 51's title is verses 1–2, so verse 1 in English Bibles is verse 3 here.
zh: 亞捫人的拉巴就是今天約旦的首都安曼；城堡山上仍有古代遺跡。
赫人在安納托利亞（今土耳其）建立的帝國，延續到約主前1180年。迦南也住着稱為赫人的居民。
按本站的經文編號，詩篇第51篇的標題是第1至2節，所以英文聖經的第1節在這裏是第3節。

en: Psalm 1: happy is the one who delights in the LORD's law, like a tree by streams of water.
The wicked are like chaff blown away; the LORD knows the way of the righteous.
Psalm 23: the LORD is my shepherd; he leads me beside quiet waters.
Even in the darkest valley, "I will fear no harm, for you are with me."
Psalm 100: all the earth is called to shout to the LORD and serve him with gladness.
We are his people, the sheep of his pasture; his faithful love endures forever.
Psalm 139: the LORD knows me, is present everywhere, and wove me in my mother's womb.
zh: 詩篇第1篇：喜愛耶和華律法的人多麼有福，他好像栽在溪水旁的樹。
惡人像被風吹散的糠秕；耶和華知道義人的道路。
詩篇第23篇：耶和華是我的牧者，他領我到安靜的水邊。
即使走過最黑暗的山谷，「我也不怕遭害，因為你與我同在」。
詩篇第100篇：全地都要向耶和華歡呼，歡歡喜喜地事奉他。
我們是他的子民，是他草場上的羊；他的慈愛永遠長存。
詩篇第139篇：耶和華認識我，無處不在，在母腹中編織了我。

about.en: The one who trusts the LORD is like a tree by water
about.zh: 倚靠耶和華的人像栽在水旁的樹

about.en: Jesus: "I am the good shepherd"
about.zh: 耶穌說：「我是好牧人」

about.en: The Lamb will be their shepherd
about.zh: 羔羊要作他們的牧者

about.en: Teach one another with psalms, hymns and songs
about.zh: 用詩篇、頌詞和靈歌彼此教導

en: The Book of Psalms has 150 psalms in five books (1–41, 42–72, 73–89, 90–106, 107–150). Its Hebrew name, Tehillim, means "praises".
The Hebrew titles name David in 73 psalms. In this Bible's numbering a title often counts as verse 1.
A shepherd carried a rod, a short club for driving off animals, and a staff for guiding the flock.
zh: 詩篇共150篇，分為五卷（1–41、42–72、73–89、90–106、107–150篇）。希伯來文書名Tehillim意思是「讚美」。
希伯來文標題中有73篇提到大衛。按本站的經文編號，標題常算作第1節。
牧人帶着杖和竿：杖是趕走野獸的短棍，竿用來引導羊群。

en: Solomon loves the LORD but sacrifices at the high places.
At Gibeon the LORD appears to him in a dream: "Ask for whatever you want."
Solomon says he is only a young boy and asks for a listening heart to govern.
God gives him a wise heart, and also riches and honor he did not ask for.
Two women come to the king, each claiming the same living baby.
The king orders the child cut in two; the real mother begs him to give the child away.
All Israel sees that the wisdom of God is in him to do justice.
zh: 所羅門愛耶和華，但仍在丘壇上獻祭。
耶和華在基遍的夢中向他顯現：「你要我賜你甚麼，可以求。」
所羅門說自己只是個年輕孩子，求一顆善於聆聽的心來治理百姓。
神賜他智慧的心，又賜他沒有求的富足和尊榮。
兩個婦人來到王面前，都說那活着的嬰孩是自己的。
王吩咐把孩子劈成兩半；孩子真正的母親求王把孩子給對方。
以色列眾人看見他心裏有神的智慧，能秉公斷案。

about.en: Solomon's request told in Chronicles
about.zh: 歷代志記載所羅門的祈求

about.en: Jesus: something greater than Solomon is here
about.zh: 耶穌說：這裏有一位比所羅門更大的

about.en: Whoever lacks wisdom should ask God
about.zh: 缺少智慧的，應當求神

en: Solomon reigned about 970–930 BC.
Gibeon is el-Jib, about 9 km northwest of Jerusalem. Excavations there found a great rock-cut pool and jar handles inscribed with the name Gibeon.
High places were open-air shrines, often on hilltops, with an altar for sacrifice.
zh: 所羅門作王約在主前970至930年。
基遍就是耶路撒冷西北約9公里的吉布村。考古在那裏發現了一個在岩石中鑿成的大水池，以及刻有「基遍」字樣的瓶把。
丘壇是露天的敬拜場所，常在山頂上，設有獻祭的壇。

en: In the 480th year after the exodus, Solomon's fourth year, he begins the house of the LORD.
It is 60 cubits long, 20 wide and 30 high, built of stone finished at the quarry.
Cedar lines the walls; the inner sanctuary, with two olive-wood cherubim, is overlaid with gold.
The house is finished in Solomon's eleventh year, after seven years of work.
The priests bring the ark, holding the two stone tablets, into the most holy place.
A cloud fills the house, for the glory of the LORD fills it.
Solomon prays: heaven cannot contain God; may he hear when his people pray toward this house.
zh: 以色列人出埃及後第四百八十年，所羅門在位第四年，他開始建造耶和華的殿。
殿長六十肘，寬二十肘，高三十肘，用在石場預先鑿好的石頭建造。
牆用香柏木貼裏；內殿有兩個橄欖木的基路伯，都用金子包裹。
殿在所羅門第十一年完工，共建了七年。
祭司把放着兩塊石版的約櫃抬進至聖所。
有雲充滿了殿，因為耶和華的榮耀充滿了耶和華的殿。
所羅門禱告：天尚且不能容納神；求神垂聽他的子民向這殿所獻的禱告。

about.en: Fire comes down and the glory fills the house
about.zh: 火從天降下，榮耀充滿聖殿

about.en: Stephen: the Most High does not live in houses made by hands
about.zh: 司提反說：至高者不住人手所造的殿

about.en: Jesus speaks of the temple of his body
about.zh: 耶穌以自己的身體為殿

about.en: In the new Jerusalem the Lord and the Lamb are its temple
about.zh: 新耶路撒冷以主和羔羊為殿

en: A cubit was about 45 cm, so the house was about 27 m long, 9 m wide and 13.5 m high.
Solomon's fourth year was about 966 BC. Counting back 480 years gives the exodus date of about 1446 BC; others take 480 as a round number.
The temple stood on today's Temple Mount, where the Dome of the Rock now stands. No remains of Solomon's temple have been identified.
zh: 一肘約45厘米，所以殿長約27米、寬約9米、高約13.5米。
所羅門第四年約在主前966年。往前推480年，得出出埃及約在主前1446年；也有人認為480是約數。
聖殿建在今天的聖殿山上，現在那裏有圓頂清真寺。所羅門聖殿的遺跡至今沒有找到。

title.en: Proverbs and Ecclesiastes: wisdom for life
title.zh: 箴言和傳道書：生活的智慧

en: The proverbs of Solomon are given for learning wisdom and discipline.
"The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge."
A father warns his son not to join sinners who lie in wait to shed blood.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and he will make your paths straight.
Wisdom is worth more than silver and gold; she is a tree of life.
Ecclesiastes: for everything there is a season, a time for every matter under heaven.
The Teacher ends: "Fear God and keep his commands."
zh: 所羅門的箴言是為了使人學習智慧和管教。
「敬畏耶和華是知識的開端。」
父親警告兒子，不要隨從埋伏殺人的罪人。
要全心信靠耶和華，他必使你的路平直。
智慧比金銀更寶貴，她是生命樹。
傳道書：凡事都有定期，天下每一件事都有時候。
傳道者總結說：「要敬畏神，謹守他的誡命。」

about.en: Solomon's wisdom and his 3,000 proverbs
about.zh: 所羅門的智慧和他的三千句箴言

about.en: Hebrews quotes Proverbs 3:11-12 on discipline
about.zh: 希伯來書引用箴言論管教

about.en: James quotes Proverbs 3:34: grace to the humble
about.zh: 雅各引用箴言：賜恩給謙卑的人

about.en: Christ became for us wisdom from God
about.zh: 基督成了我們從神而來的智慧

en: Proverbs also includes sayings of others: "the wise" (22:17), Agur (30:1) and King Lemuel (31:1); Hezekiah's men copied some (25:1).
Ecclesiastes is traditionally ascribed to Solomon; many scholars date it later. Its Hebrew name, Qohelet, means one who gathers an assembly: "the Teacher".
Wisdom writing was common in the ancient Near East. The Egyptian Instruction of Amenemope has close parallels to Proverbs 22:17–24:22.
zh: 箴言也收錄了別人的話：「智慧人的話」（22章17節）、亞古珥（30章1節）和利慕伊勒王（31章1節）；有些是希西家的人抄錄的（25章1節）。
傳道書按傳統認為是所羅門所寫，許多學者認為成書較晚。希伯來文書名Qohelet指召集會眾的人，即「傳道者」。
智慧文學在古代近東很普遍。埃及的《阿蒙尼姆普的教訓》與箴言22章17節至24章22節非常相似。
